target: world_base after #158 R-1 and the B2 name-pool DDL delta

world_revision_id.description: Supplied by the B2 importer for the target revision; game-base data must not invent it.

null_encoding: empty CSV cell maps to SQL NULL
selection_rule: Procedural ordinary-name selection admits only status=approved and selection_class=ordinary; monastic, dynastic and significant rows are excluded.
required_ddl_delta: Replace current UNIQUE(name_pool_id, name_form) with UNIQUE(name_pool_id, name_form, sex_category, people_ref), and add nullable derivation_class text; the same form may validly belong to different peoples or sex categories, while calendar_name_any_christian records why a form remains ordinary.
activation_rule: Only approved pools and approved entries are runtime-selectable; draft rows are authoring data.
